label: a1-vs-a2 leaning from last trial outcome and belief; unrewarded raises at D1
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 39: high (~0.7) at D1/GO, low (~0.15) at D2; timing explains R^2 0.92. Beyond timing, uses observed quantities only: (1) at D1 the previous trial's outcome: unrewarded trials raise it (a1 S2 u +0.14, a2 S2 u +0.10, a1 S1 u +0.08), rewarded ones lower it, strongest after a2 S1 r (-0.13). (2) at GO it tracks a model-based leaning toward a1: higher after a1 S1 r / a1 S2 u / a1 S2 r, much lower after a2 S1 u (-0.20), plus a graded increase with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good (belief_lo). (3) at D2 the previous trial (a1 S2 u +0.10) plus this trial's choice x reached state (a1->S2 rare +0.09, a2->S1 -0.06). Trial-before tables and D2 belief added ~0 once belief and last trial were in; reward-streak terms added <0.01. No future variables. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.70 (dev 0.71) vs all-observed reference 0.80 and all ceiling 0.88; the earlier model-policy explanation (policy decile alone 0.58) is largely replaced by belief_lo + last-trial tables at GO. Residual errors are cumulative streaks (repeated a2 S1 u pushing GO to ~0.2, repeated a1 S1 r pushing D1 to ~0.55).

issues: Reproduced: test R^2 beyond timing is 0.7012 (timing-only R^2 0.923, total 0.977). Misses show mean error by phase of 0.000 to 0.003, and the largest cell errors by phase x previous trial are about ±0.027 (GO after a1 S2 r / a2 S2 r +0.027/+0.024, GO after a2 S2 u -0.024). That is small and scattered.

The D1 claim 'unrewarded raises, rewarded lowers' is only roughly true. a2 S1 u (rare unrewarded) is +0.002 at D1, not raised, and a1 S2 r (rare rewarded) is +0.032, slightly raised rather than lowered. The pattern holds for common trials only.

The claim that 'tables for the trial before added about 0' is overstated. Adding the trial-before table at GO and D1 (shaped like the last-trial tables) raises test R^2 from 0.701 to 0.723 (+0.022). Adding that plus a GO last_is('a2 S1 u')*belief_lo interaction gives 0.729.

The GO belief_lo term is modest. Dropping it costs 0.027 (0.674 without it). Dropping the D2 action x state table costs 0.033. Both claims hold, but belief is not a large driver beyond the last-trial tables.

There is a systematic streak error, which the explanation acknowledges. During long a1 S1 r runs the unit is over-predicted in all three phases, not only at D1: D1 0.53-0.56 vs 0.63-0.69 predicted, GO 0.72 vs 0.79-0.80, D2 0.10 vs 0.17-0.18. Repeated a2 S1 u pushes GO to about 0.2 against a predicted 0.53. Streak indicators add only about 0.01-0.03 of test R^2, so this class is large in single windows but small in variance.
There is still a gap of about 0.10 to the all-observed reference (0.80). No term set within 8 terms that I tried got past 0.73.
The label's 'a1-vs-a2 leaning' really describes only GO. At D1 the drive is mostly an unrewarded-vs-rewarded effect, mainly after common transitions.
skeptic.revised_label: r39: raised at D1 after common unrewarded trials, lowered after rewarded ones; at GO it leans toward a1 (last-trial pattern plus belief_lo); saturates on streaks
